issues.display_title: Issue #4173: Delete from Street View button has incorrect rounded corners
issues.main_description_html:
Description

On the Tour Detail page, the Delete from Street View button appears fully rounded even though it is grouped with the Open Street View Contribution Page button.

The two buttons should look like one connected button group. The shared corners between them should not be rounded.

Expected Result

  • The Delete from Street View button is rounded only on its outer right corners.
  • Its left side connects seamlessly with the Open Street View Contribution Page button.
  • Existing button actions and states continue to work as before.

issues.display_title: Issue #4175: Refresh panorama PlaceID after successful update
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

After changing a panorama PlaceID from the panorama detail page, the GoThru detail table continues showing the previous value until the page is reloaded.

Expected behavior

  • A successful PlaceID update immediately appears in the GoThru detail table.
  • The existing success toast remains and the modal closes.
  • Panorama details are refetched after the local update so the UI reconciles with the persisted server value.
  • A failed update leaves the existing table value unchanged and keeps the modal open.
  • Reopening the modal shows the current PlaceID.

Scope

Keep existing subscription access, input validation, Google PlaceID controls, error handling, and unrelated panorama actions unchanged.
